item.title: Pavement obstruction, 8th October
item.description:
The Boxing Gym on Chatsworth Parade is using the whole width of pavement each evening during their classes for at least 15 to 20 children to run the length of Chatsworth Parade charging towards pedestrians who are trying to get to.Morrisons or home from work. When asked if the children could run on one half of the pavement, I was dismissed. It is dark and dangerous at 7pm at night and the pavement is for pedestrians not gym training sessions. I have seen this over the last few weeks most early evenings between around 6.30pm to 7.30pm.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 8, Queensway, Poverest, Orpington, Greater London
